title: Automated quality sentinels for split-tests and shadow traffic
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Summary: Implement a lightweight, automated 'quality sentinel' subsystem that evaluates model candidates during split-tests (A/B) and shadow/mirrored traffic. The sentinel will run a compact reference prompt corpus plus sampled live traffic probes, compute a multi-dimensional scorecard (quality delta, regression rate, latency delta, token-level divergence, simple hallucination proxy, safety score), and enforce soft and hard gating policies that can trigger alerts or automatic rollback via the rollout controller.

Motivation: Current canary and A/B flows lack consistent, automated quality checks tied to curated prompt sets and live shadowing. We want to reduce silent regressions reaching production by surfacing small but material quality drops and enabling fast, reversible rollouts.

Scope: Build the sentinel runner and metrics pipeline, wire it into the rollout API and route-engine, add configuration flags in the Console for sentinels (enable/disable, thresholds, synthetic probe rate), produce dashboards and runbook, and implement opt-in auto-rollback behavior. This ticket covers the engineering implementation and integration work; follow-ups will cover UX polish and long-tail eval corpus expansion.
acceptance_criteria: A sentinel process runs for every split-test and shadow deployment and produces a per-rollout JSON scorecard (quality_delta, regressions_pct, latency_p99_delta, token_divergence) within 30s of evaluation completion.
Sentinel uses both: (a) a configurable reference prompt corpus (min 200 prompts) and (b) sampled mirrored live requests (default 1% of traffic) for cross-checks.
Soft-gate: when quality_delta > configured soft_threshold, system pages #rollouts-alerts and annotates the rollout UI but does not change routing.

Hard-gate: when regressions_pct or safety_score crosses hard_threshold, the rollout controller can automatically rollback the candidate to the previous model if auto-rollback is enabled in the rollout config.
Metrics emitted to existing observability stack (Grafana/Influx/Tracing) with per-model, per-route breakdowns and an aggregate dashboard link in the ticket.
End-to-end tests validate: sentinel triggered, scorecard computed, webhook to rollout-api invoked, and rollback executed when configured (mocked service test).
Documentation: Console flag docs + runbook added (link in 'links').
tasks: Design and implement sentinel runner service + container (metrics export, config loader).
Integrate reference prompt corpus store and a sampling shim for mirrored traffic.
Implement multi-dimensional scorecard computation and normalization (quality_delta, regression detection heuristic, latency deltas, token divergence).
Extend rollout controller API: accept sentinel webhooks, evaluate gating rules, and optionally trigger rollback.
Add console flags/UI to enable/disable sentinels per-environment and configure thresholds.
Create Grafana dashboard and alert rules; wire alerts to #rollouts-alerts with clear runbook links.
Write unit and e2e tests and a simulated canary flow test harness.
Security review and threat model (KMS for corpus access, no PII retention).
comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha Kaur: Initial ticket created. Prototype goals: low-latency scorecards, conservative defaults to avoid noisy rollbacks.

2026-02-12 Miguel Torres: Spike complete — prototype runner computes BLEU-like overlap and a token-divergence metric. Found that live traffic sampling at 1% yields 30-100 useful probes / minute on mid-size routes.

2026-02-13 Samir Patel (Applied ML): Note — overlap heuristics undercount paraphrase regressions. Propose adding semantic-similarity embedding check for high-risk routes later; keep initial heuristics lightweight.

2026-02-15 Lena Weiss (Product): Keep default hard_threshold conservative (e.g., regressions_pct > 5%) and make auto-rollback opt-in for enterprise customers only. We need strong telemetry before turning this on for hosted tenants.
2026-02-17 Miguel Torres: Wire-up done for rollout-api webhook; pushing PR for review. Auto-rollback branch wired behind rollout config flag 'sentinel_auto_rollback'.
2026-02-18 Aisha Kaur: Added Grafana dashboard stub and runbook draft. Requesting security review for corpus access patterns (see link).
